business_problem: To help support the company’s fast growth, the company had moved to SAP Business ByDesign. The problem was the front end. While ideal for purchasing specialists, the UI for entering purchase requests (PRs) was simply too complicated and time consuming for the company’s main users – who, in this case, were mostly marketers driven by tight execution schedules.
solution_summary: To help support the company’s fast growth, the company had moved to SAP Business ByDesign. The problem was the front end. Avocados From Mexico is a non-profit marketing organization which supports importers and distributors of Mexican avocados across the US. The company used Power Platform to create a customized app to help streamline purchase order processing with integration to their SAP ByDesign system. “By simplifying our purchase order process using Power Platform, every PO that used to take up to 15 minutes to process can now be done in less than a minute.” The company’s iconic TV commercials ( like this one on their site ) have appeared in Big Game football broadcasts for several years. But what a lot of people don’t realize is that the company driving the Avocados From Mexico brand is a non-profit organization with the same name that is comprised just over 30 people.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Delivers the low-code application interface used by employees to capture, review, or act on operational data.

solution_components.name: SAP Business ByDesign
solution_components.role: Acts as the ERP system that receives streamlined transactions from the new workflow.

data_flow: Data from SAP Business ByDesign is routed through Power Platform workflows, stored or synchronized in the core application data layer, and surfaced to users through Power Apps and Power Automate for execution, reporting, and follow-up actions.
